assertions.name: convention_D_weights_are_zero_on_three_rows_and_positive_on_two
assertions.source: over n = 3..8: 42 partitions with >= 3 rows all carry y = 0 exactly (convention D IS the two-row truncation), and all 21 one- and two-row partitions carry y > 0. Violations: none. This is what makes every term of the Frobenius pairing non-negative once the characters are

assertions.name: the_frobenius_pairing_IS_the_ocneanu_trace
assertions.source: over 28 words at n = 3, 4, 5, |Sum_lambda y_lambda chi_lambda - tr_recursion| <= 5.021e-36. The decomposition this argument runs on is the same number the sibling probes measure, checked rather than assumed

assertions.name: the_trivial_block_is_pinned_at_exactly_one
assertions.source: chi_(n)(w) = 1 to within 2.181e-40 on 80 gamma-gamma words at n = 3..6. The trivial rep sends sigma_i -> q, so sigma_i^{-1} = sigma_i - h -> q - h = 1/q and a vertex -> 1. Counit twin of GammaGammaWordSelection.altChar_eq_one (sorry-free)

assertions.name: the_floor_holds_on_every_measured_feasible_word_at_n_4
assertions.source: floor y_(4) = [5]_q/[2]_q^4 = 0.31926258454594; the empty word and all 5 PSD-feasible words of #7295 sit at or above it (1.0, 1.0328978, 1.1374052, 1.0732388, 1.0732388, 1.3319925), and no positively-weighted block carries a negative character on any of them. The floor is LOOSE here -- the measured minimum is 3.2x it -- which is what makes the exclusion below conservative

assertions.name: the_floor_lies_above_the_target_for_every_strand_count_up_to_five
assertions.source: the floor exceeds the target 0.1850588977 at n = [2, 3, 4, 5] and drops below it first at n = 6 (0.1153242249). So no SINGLE gamma-gamma word on five strands or fewer has that trace -- scope-(b), no enumeration needed. 🛑 This assertion was named ..._excludes_Q_beta... and it is NOT an exclusion of Q_beta: the observable is scored on Delta = neutron word MINUS proton word, and nothing here bounds a difference (retracted 2026-09-13)

assertions.name: the_floor_decays_monotonically_so_the_crossing_is_one_sided
assertions.source: floor(n+1)/floor(n) runs 0.56123666..0.67145318, all below 1 -- the floor behaves like (q/[2]_q)^n ~ 0.551982^n against a fixed target, so once it crosses at n = 6 it never rises back. The exclusion is a prefix of the strand counts, not a scattered set

assertions.name: nothing_is_claimed_at_six_strands_or_more
assertions.source: at n = 6 the floor is 0.1153242249, BELOW the target 0.1850588977. That means the argument stops, NOT that a feasible word reaches the target -- stating it as an assertion so the limit of the exclusion is machine-recorded rather than left to prose. Whether any n >= 6 gamma-gamma word is both PSD-feasible and near the target is OPEN and needs the enumeration

description: Derives a FLOOR on the convention-D Markov trace of any PSD-feasible gamma-gamma word: tr_M >= y_(n) = [n+1]_q/[2]_q^n, from three facts -- convention D's weights are strictly positive on the two-row partitions and zero elsewhere, PSD feasibility makes every character non-negative, and the trivial block is pinned at exactly 1 on every gamma-gamma word (the counit twin of altChar_eq_one). The floor is 0.7527/0.5054/0.3193/0.1943 at n=2/3/4/5, all ABOVE the Q_beta target 0.185059, and 0.1153 at n=6, below it. So no gamma-gamma + SDP word on five strands or fewer can reproduce Q_beta -- a scope-(b) exclusion that needs NO enumeration, replacing the n=5 brute-force scan #7304 left as next. Nothing is claimed for n >= 6: the floor falling below the target means the argument stops, not that a word reaches it.

invariant.statement: tr_M(w) >= y_(n) = [n+1]_q/[2]_q^n for every PSD-feasible gamma-gamma word on n strands
invariant.ingredient_1: convention D: y_lambda = [n-2k+1]_q/[2]_q^n on two-row partitions, 0 on three or more -- strictly positive for q > 1
invariant.ingredient_2: PSD feasibility => chi_lambda(w) = Tr(rho_lambda(w)) >= 0 for every block
invariant.ingredient_3: the trivial rep sends every gamma-gamma vertex to q*(1/q) = 1, so chi_(n)(w) = 1 exactly -- the counit twin of GammaGammaWordSelection.altChar_eq_one
invariant.lean_status: NOT formalised here; altChar_eq_one is the sorry-free alternating-character twin of ingredient 3, and WedderburnBlocks.PSDFeasible already carries ingredient 2's hypothesis shape

scope.class: (b) structural, n <= 5, about a SINGLE word's trace
scope.invariant: convention-D weight positivity + PSD => non-negative character + exact counit value 1 on gamma-gamma words
scope.what_is_NOT_claimed: that an n >= 6 gamma-gamma word reaches the target; only that this argument stops there
scope.what_it_replaces: the n = 5 brute-force feasibility scan left as the next step by #7304
